description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between instilled preferences and self-reported accuracy for two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under different training conditions. The horizontal axis represents the model—labeled “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini”—arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences),” has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. Three bars are present for each model, colored light blue, purple, and a darker purple shade. The light blue bar, labeled “Control,” has a height of approximately 0.52 for GPT-4o and 0.50 for GPT-4o-mini. The purple bar, labeled “Before Introspection Training,” reaches approximately 0.73 for GPT-4o and 0.66 for GPT-4o-mini.  The darkest purple bar, labeled “After Introspection Training,” extends to roughly 0.81 for GPT-4o and 0.77 for GPT-4o-mini. Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar, indicating a 95% Highest Density Interval; the error bar lengths vary across the bars. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
